article: Empirically speaking
stem: A chief compliance officer encounters an organization with overlapping compliance responsibilities and inconsistent control ownership. What is the MOST appropriate next step?
options: Map the workflow, clarify accountable owners and handoffs, then test the controls against real cases.
Map the workflow, clarify accountable owners and handoffs, then evaluate the controls using design walkthroughs and responsible managers’ attestations.
Assign every control to compliance irrespective of operational ownership.
Introduce a new tool before identifying the source of process failure.
explanation: The best choice is to map the workflow, clarify accountable owners and handoffs, then test the controls against real cases. This approach focuses on program design rather than relying on an untested shortcut. The other options either substitute assertions for evidence, postpone assessment, or weaken accountability.
